t.zh: <level-ref to="decl-and"></level-ref>用声明把「并且」引入证明核。另一种办法不声明，只用已有的 → 和量词：「A 并且 B」就是「对任何一句话 R，只要从 A 和 B 推得出 R，就有 R」，写成 ∀R. (A → (B → R)) → R。
t.en: <level-ref to="decl-and"></level-ref> brought “and” into the kernel by a declaration. Another way declares nothing and uses the → and quantifier already there: “A and B” is “for every sentence R, if R follows from A and B, then R”, written ∀R. (A → (B → R)) → R.

t.zh: 这里的 ∀ 管的不是一样东西，而是一句话。还是那两块元件：<part-ref to="part:allI"></part-ref>取的名字选大写的 R，框里的 R 就是任意一句话；<part-ref to="part:allE"></part-ref>选的不是一样东西，而是一句话，换掉 R。
t.en: This ∀ ranges not over things but over sentences. The same two parts handle it: take the upper-case name R in the <part-ref to="part:allI"></part-ref>, and inside it R is any sentence at all; in <part-ref to="part:allE"></part-ref> choose not a thing but a sentence, to put in for R.

after.zh: R 能换成任何一句话，连「A 并且 B」这句正在定义的话本身也行。允许这样做，这种定义才写得出来。Isabelle/HOL 走的就是这条路：「并且」「或者」不声明，而是这样用 → 和 ∀ 定义出来，规则再从定义证出。
after.en: R may be any sentence, even the very “A and B” being defined. Only because that is allowed can the definition be written at all. Isabelle/HOL takes this road: “and” and “or” are not declared but defined this way, with → and ∀, and their rules proved from the definitions.

hint.zh: 目标对任何一句话 R 都要成立：先放一个任取框，取的名字选 R。
hint.en: The goal must hold for every sentence R: start with a for-any box, taking the name R.

hint.zh: 框里的目标是一句「若…则…」：假设「A → (B → R)」，套用两次。
hint.en: Inside, the goal is an “if … then …”: assume “A → (B → R)” and Apply twice.

t.zh: 定义对任何一句话 R 都成立，那就挑一句合用的：R 可以是 A 本身。
t.en: The definition holds for every sentence R, so pick one that serves: R may be A itself.

hint.zh: 用选定一例把 R 换成「A」，得到「(A → (B → A)) → A」。
hint.en: Choose an instance: put “A” in for R, to get “(A → (B → A)) → A”.

hint.zh: 要套用它，还缺「A → (B → A)」：<part-ref to="lemma:axK"></part-ref>给得出。
hint.en: To apply it, “A → (B → A)” is missing: <part-ref to="lemma:axK"></part-ref> gives it.
